headline: Danske Bank and Coop Bank Launch AI Banking Agents for Customers
summary: Danske Bank and Coop Bank introduced direct customer access to accounts and investment portfolios via specialized artificial intelligence agents.
why: Danske Bank is the largest financial services group in Denmark, competing in digital retail and corporate banking.

impacts.name: Danske Bank
impacts.why: Deploying generative AI tools aims to automate and enhance digital customer service.
